description: The GOP leadership in Missouri is out of control. Denny Hoskins has disgraced himself. We should not reward bad leadership with a renewed position. I believe he should resign. But at the very least, we should vote him out of office in the next election. There has to be consequences for bad behavior, and that has to come from us, the voters. It is OUR job to hold elected officials to account, and that's why it's so important for everyone to vote. We have to send a message - we expect better. Denn
title: Vote 'em out
